latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate and parse resumes and cover letters from structured data.

- Create professional, ATS-optimized resumes and tailored cover letters via the /generate endpoint.
- Accept detailed candidate data, including experiences, education, skills, certifications, and more.
- Optionally parse unstructured resumes into structured data for editing or re-generation via /parse-resume.
- Provides download URLs for generated documents.
- Includes endpoints for service health/status checks.
